summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a 6-K disclosing a new £1 billion share buyback programme commencing 31 July 2026, with Goldman Sachs International acting as broker. The programme is aimed at reducing ordinary share capital and shares purchased will be cancelled. It runs until no later than 27 January 2027 and is subject to PRA approval. No purchases will be made in the US or for ADRs. This is an issuer share repurchase, a capital return event. What to watch: execution pace and any regulatory constraints.
